headline: Taylor Creek lock open every day again
what: The S-193 boat lock at Taylor Creek, weekends-only since late September after a low-water closure, is back to seven days a week.
why: It's the boater's way from the lake into the town of Okeechobee – fuel, groceries, restaurants – with no more weekday waits.
todo: Arrive before 9pm. Four other north-shore locks (S-135, G-36, S-127, S-131) are still closed. Lock operator: 863-532-8042.

headline: Harvest Moon Regatta sails Thursday
dateline: Start Thu Oct 22, 2pm · Awards Sat Oct 24, Port Aransas
what: Lakewood Yacht Club's 39th annual offshore race to Port Aransas, with trophies for both racing and cruising classes.
why: An offshore fleet racing down the Texas coast – fun to follow, and worth knowing if you're making the same run that week.
todo: Moving down the coast Oct 22–24? Expect a big fleet offshore, keep a sharp night watch, and call ahead for a Port Aransas slip.
